Pilot (classes-18, 2 starts per class, 300,000 turns): the gate is that no cell has a config_error and every game
ends in death or at the cap. Everything is directional; a claim needs a fresh seed block (RULES 14). Pairs: save2
against ctl, save2-noov against ctl and against save2 (the overrides). Primary measures, fixed here, per class:
(1) flasks of oil thrown per game, adjacent and at range; (2) flasks carried at each town departure and return, and
games that run out of light fuel or flasks; (3) deaths, with rescued and newly killed pairs against ctl, and deaths
within 20 turns of a fight where a flask was saved; (4) HP lost per kill and turns per kill against monsters the
shipped Borg throws at; (5) mean max CL and depth, and alive at the cap.
